title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode5 Brushing At The Depths Of Pain

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Episode: Episode5 — Brushing At The Depths Of Pain
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like the more I try to draw, the more confused I get...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, I'm never gonna be able to prove him wrong... I have to make him acknowledge my talent...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, I haven't been able to draw anything since the exam...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Ugh, my head...
I can't go on...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I should lie down and rest for a bit before trying again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe it's a notification from PicShare!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if someone liked one of my old illustrations?!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, it's just recommending someone else's post...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've posted pretty much everything I've drawn, but they've gotten hardly any likes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was convinced that was because everyone on PicShare only cared about looking at the manga and the anime art that people post...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I'm really not that good...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now it's telling me about popular posts! PicShare's been sending me all these pointless notifications since that update...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A high school girl got 300 likes just for a selfie...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Geez, talk about too much editing. She went way overboard under her eyes. Honestly, I'd probably look 100 times cuter.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (See? Just hide one eye, touch it up a bit and I'll have 300 likes in no time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll put it on silent to shut it up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yikes... I just wanted to rest my eyes, but ended up sleeping for a while...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What time is it?
Where did I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What's with all these notifications...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Too cute!!>
<Super cute!>
<Your face is adorable! I wanna see more!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I wasn't expecting this kind of response...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, another notification...
Geez, how viral is this gonna get...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't be acting all satisfied...
It's just a stupid selfie...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I kinda feel like I can draw something really good now. I'll give it a go after I have breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing's changed... Or have I gotten worse...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't get the image in my head onto paper. It doesn't matter what I draw. The more I try, the worse things get...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This feels weird...
All these people are looking at my selfie...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So cute!>
<Do you not have any makeup on?! Your skin's so pretty!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, this isn't how I want to get noticed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, breaktime's over.
I'll start over and redraw it from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't understand what I'm doing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Can you post a makeup video?>
<She must be naturally this cute.>
<I envy girls with cute faces...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Alright, fine...
I'll take one of my upper body. At least I can use it as a reference for drawing human figures.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll touch up the colors a bit... Yeah, this should work...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, she's so cute!>
<Your eyelashes are so long! Jealous!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Her hair's pretty too.>
<And she's so slim.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this angle seems like the better choice. As for my light source...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm getting nowhere with my drawing, so it's okay if I do this for a little bit longer...right?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, the one I took last week has 2,000 likes...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How awesome am I?
That's way more than your run-of-the-mill idol.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe I really am that cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if this is what I'm really meant to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't what I want... I don't want likes for this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to draw something... Anything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I lose my ability to draw, then I'd really...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why am I so bad at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can't draw... I might just try to disappear.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to go somewhere that's devoid of other people...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm such an idiot...
I know full well that this kind of praise is pointless.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, I still want their likes...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <This song made me cry like a baby. I want to thank everybody who was there for me when I really needed them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, it's recommending me another post... Wait, it's just someone's opinion on a song.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This has been happening a lot.
People write all these comments hoping that other people say that they agree or that they're right...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We all want attention. We just want to be noticed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's why we write these sorts of posts, upload pics and try to get likes... To be seen...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(...?
Huh? Did I just press play...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hang on... This song...
It feels really dark, but it's having this weird effect on me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Who posted this...? K...?
Are they famous or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(My chest... It kinda hurts...
Is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, is that it...?
I'm in pain...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This song's so sad...
It's full of pain and suffering, and makes me really want to disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like it's saying, “No, don't disappear yet.”)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's right...
I don't want to disappear yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care if I lose my ability to draw... I'll keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to draw...! I want to keep drawing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm struggling to draw the way I want and don't even know what I want to draw, but...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that light piercing through the darkness...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Like I can't go anywhere right now, but I can see light at the end of the tunnel...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Or like being lost in a really dark forest where only the moon is visible... And it looks so beautiful... But it also makes you want to shout your lungs out...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't really know where I'm going with this...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I want to use this idea... I want to draw it!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, my hands are all black...
I should wash my hands later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I uploaded it...
But still no likes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I ended up falling asleep after that... I'm aching all over too. Probably because I drew for so long in such a weird posture...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I ever gonna be able to draw anything like what I did yesterday again...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I shouldn't look...
If I do, I'll get sucked back in.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...? Hold on...
That last one wasn't a like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They used my drawing to make a music video...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It wasn't a waste after all...
